protocol.prepare: Linux support probe before Popen; supervisor sets subreaper and forks blocked worker before READY. Caller durably binds identity then explicitly starts.
protocol.pid: Public pid is real worker PID, separate supervisor identity and retained supervisor pidfd.
protocol.closure: Integer status requires matching TREE_CLOSED plus supervisor exit 0. WNOHANG=0 is pending, not ECHILD. Sole supervisor waitpid owner uses __WALL.
protocol.stopping: Only private STOP or channel loss triggers cleanup; pidfd signals target verified direct/adopted children. No PGID/raw PID fallback. Natural useful descendants are not automatically killed.
protocol.lease: Supplied lease fds survive worker exec and are retained by supervisor until tree closure; IPC/gate fds are not exec-inherited.
protocol.outcome: Worker returncode remains actual status; stop_requested/forced_cleanup are separate facts. Native adapter must not promote stopped leader-0 to success.
protocol.uncertainty: Post-Popen setup errors and supervisor/channel loss are not NOT_STARTED or ordinary failed exit. No crash adoption or automatic restart authority.

primary_sources.checked: Nearest living subreaper adopts orphan descendants and can wait for them; flag not inherited by fork/clone, preserved across exec.
Stable child reference relies on no explicit SIGCHLD ignore / NOCLDWAIT and no separate reaper; supervisor single thread sets SIGCHLD default.
Signals use stable pidfds instead of PID reuse-prone numbers.

linux_evidence.waitpid_fetch_note: This turn's waitpid.2 and wait.2 web opens timed out. __WALL was checked in the local Linux UAPI header, and actual Linux process tests exercise waitpid(-1,WNOHANG|__WALL).

limits: Linux only; no unsafe non-Linux/pidfd fallback
Private setup frame <= 1 MiB; identity <= 16 KiB; no cmd/env/raw nonce in persistent binding or process argv
Not hostile same-UID or namespace sandbox; no host process-table kill scan
Unkillable/unconfirmed owned descendants retain supervisor/lease and caller HOLD
No recovery adoption or durable supervisor-side receipt store; parent must persist accepted closure with terminal effect
No guarantees for legacy unsupervised evaluation or training/lineage in this slice
